title: Problems to fix found while preparing the durable multi-agent HV architecture amendment (pulled into the HV plan)
description: Single tracking item for every problem found while preparing the durable multi-agent hostile validation (HV) architecture amendment (operator, 2026-10-16T14:00 local, verbatim: "keep track of problems to fix as a single todo item that will be pulled into the plan."). The HV plan PLAN-HVPIPELINE-001 pulls these items in (its last task; assignment in amendment section 20.4); nothing here is fixed by the documentation-only amendment, whose section 21 registers these problems (commits 31af8c597e3570a2469a48a238a4aa76107f30bb, 99cb42b24a442377a776aebd58e9df6894c2ce40, 9fd6b653b2522212ad8151091e3a8cdec25e75bd, 6dbc384323c036a57c37fd9eaf2259879c1d956f, bd6e37b33f043b1ede3a1feeaf7073d357ea21cf, f5fd5ab24ad00b09053daf07ed3c0d850f70498d, d3a0beb10b0879f20fb307f205a3bff25ac3a441, and 3fba1b1336a92767904e344dbe9d531200049a0d (hostile validation round 1 remediation: P1 corrected for finding F09, the P1 task for finding F18, and the P11 and P15 requirement corrected to FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-005), and 67297000747bcfacc481bc8891c35f8fe4aff65f (hostile validation round 2 remediation: P5 split into its foundation and HostileReview parts for finding R2-F04, the P1 worker contract completed for finding R2-F03, and the P7 named check), and 92df2c49d7f06f359190b8574dd5545d7174e294 (the completed pre-round-3 read: the P3 dispatch refusal with its diagnostic, the P1 host diagram matched to its text, and the attempt storage in Addendum B.9), and 4c5208c7f6d8bbedff692d1739c4f434baed4e01 (hostile validation round 3 remediation: the P1 execution metadata and terminal-field writers for finding R3-F04, and the HostileReview sweep on the shared FencedLease Expire for R3-F01), branch docs/hv-architecture-amendment-20261016).

Source baseline: develop at 36783b79 (worktree hv-amendment-20261016, branch docs/hv-architecture-amendment-20261016). Each item states the observation with its receipt; an inference is marked as one.

P1 (requirement drift and a missing worker; corrected 2026-10-17 after HV round 1 finding F09): the exported projection docs/Project/Functional-Requirements.md:1389 shows FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003 acceptance criterion 4 (server-owned worker, durable queue, bounded at-least-once execution, at most one accepted terminal result) checked with an older text, while the store holds it with isSatisfied false and a newer text (the configured or the pooled default agent, no named model; requirement read 2026-10-17, docs/receipts/hv/hv-r1-related-requirements.json:82-84); the first version of this item called the criterion satisfied, which is true only of the projection. Either way develop registers no worker: AddHostileReviewServices registers only scoped services (src/QBrainAi.Services/Services/HostileReviewServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:11-42); AcceptReviewerOutputAsync has no caller in src (repository search 2026-10-16T13:59:31 local); the lease, renewal, attempt, retry, and timeout options are declared but read by nothing (src/QBrainAi.Services/Options/HostileReviewWorkerOptions.cs:30-46). Inference: a submitted hostile review stays Queued forever.

P2 (defect): HostileReviewService.AcceptReviewerOutputAsync checks no lease, attempt, or fence, appends an execution and overwrites Verdict on every call (src/QBrainAi.Services/Services/HostileReviewService.cs:196-273), so a duplicate completion replaces the accepted terminal result, contrary to FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003 acceptance criterion 4.

P3 (requirement drift): FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-002 says links resolve through TODO, FR/TR/TEST, session log, triage, plans, files, commits, and generated docs (docs/Project/Functional-Requirements.md:1373), but ResolveLink resolves only artifactType todo and answers artifact_missing for every other type (HostileReviewService.cs:294-314), and the stored hash is SHA-256 of the TODO id, not of its content (HostileReviewService.cs:312), so the stale-link diagnostic of :1377 cannot fire.

P4 (audit gap): McpDbContext.AppendAuditRows writes no DataAuditLog rows when IsAuditTableAvailable reports the bootstrap schema unavailable (src/QBrainAi.Storage/McpDbContext.cs:1507-1538), and only entities with an IsDeleted property are audited (IsDurableAuditableEntry, McpDbContext.cs:1620-1627); the HostileReview entities have no IsDeleted (src/QBrainAi.Storage/Entities/HostileReviewRequestEntity.cs:6-86, HostileReviewExecutionEntity.cs:7-66), so their mutations write no TR-MCP-DB-004 ledger rows. Inference: the settled HV rule that an audit failure is a hard stop cannot rely on the ledger as it behaves today.

P5 (reviewer pin drift): the foundation architecture docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture.md pins every HV and the model grader to Codex gpt-6-astra at effort max (section 3 Process at line 88, section 3.1 Trust and Model grade at lines 132 and 136, section 6.2 ModelGrader defaults at line 2691, UC-7 at line 5230), and HostileReviewWorkerOptions.Validate refuses any agent other than Astra, gpt-6-astra, xhigh (HostileReviewWorkerOptions.cs:77-82), contrary to the operator ruling of 2026-10-13 ("HV must not be executed by the same agent family as the requesting agent.  If not specified by operator, ask what agent and model to use for HV in a session.") and to the settled five-reviewer round-robin pool (Cline, Copilot, Claude, Codex, Grok). The amendment states the replacing rule; the foundation text, its plan, and the options change when the HV plan executes. Corrected 2026-10-17 after HV round 2 finding R2-F04: the two pins have different replacing rules and phases. The foundation pin (text and its plan; its ModelGrader options are architecture only) is replaced by the HV reviewer-pool rule in H0 (A-01 to A-03). The HostileReviewWorkerOptions pin is replaced by FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003 criterion 4's own rule, the configured or the pooled default agent, never the HV pool, in H3 with the HostileReview worker (amendment sections 16.7 and 20.4, named test HostileReviewWorkerUsesConfiguredOrPooledDefaultAgent).

P6 (capability gap, corrected 2026-10-16T14:10 local): the one-shot strategy has no Copilot branch: OneShotCliAgentExecutionStrategy builds launches for codex, claude, grok, and cline only and throws NotSupportedException for any other agent (src/QBrainAi.Services/Services/OneShotCliAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:238-262). Copilot runs only through the interactive copilot-cli strategy (CopilotCliAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:5-45, registered at IAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:123, wrapping IAgentCliClient.CreateInteractiveSession). Whether that path gives a non-interactive HV run with live output and runtime model and effort provenance is unverified, while the settled reviewer pool includes Copilot. (The first version of this item said no Copilot adapter exists; that was wrong.)

P8 (capability gap, operator-confirmed): the operator requires reviewer output "captured live and streamed" (Cline session message 148), but the one-shot strategy streaming methods await the whole run and then yield its body once (OneShotCliAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:57-75), so no true live streaming exists on that path today. Operator, 2026-10-16T14:14 local, verbatim: "Explains a lot.  Gotta be fixed in the plan." The HV plan must own the fix with a discriminating acceptance criterion: each output line a reviewer writes is persisted and observable on the run output stream while the reviewer process is still running (test: a scripted fake reviewer writes a line, then blocks on a gate the test controls; the line must arrive on the stream before the gate opens and before the process exits).

P7 (traceability drift): EventStreamController cites FR-MCP-045 for the SSE change stream (src/QBrainAi.Support.Mcp/Controllers/EventStreamController.cs:11), but the canonical FR-MCP-045 is "Cross-Workspace TODO Move" (requirement store read 2026-10-16T14:02:23 local); the HV reconnectable stream builds on that controller, so its requirement id must be corrected first.

P9 (defect and duplicated constants, source search 2026-10-16T15:33:38 local): develop's highest-effort constants disagree and one is refused. OneShotCliAgentExecutionStrategy passes Grok --effort max and --reasoning-effort max (src/QBrainAi.Services/Services/OneShotCliAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:26,332-335), which Grok 1.0.60 refuses with exit 1 ("--effort/--reasoning-effort: unknown effort level 'max'; use one of: xhigh, high, medium, low", probe run 2026-10-16T15:32:48 local, receipt cli-effort-probe/grok-max.stdout.txt in /home/sharpninja/.claude/receipts/McpServer/20261016T153600-hv-amendment-vi-probes/), so a one-shot Grok run fails before it starts (inference from the refused flag; the one-shot path itself was not run); GrokCliAgentExecutionStrategy uses high (src/QBrainAi.Services/Services/GrokCliAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:25,82-83); Codex is pinned to xhigh in two places (OneShotCliAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:23, CodexCliAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:21) although Codex accepted max and recorded effort max in its rollout (probe 2026-10-16T15:32:42 local); Cline xhigh is defined twice (src/QBrainAi.Common.AgentCli/AgentCliClient.cs:17, OneShotCliAgentExecutionStrategy.cs:25). The amendment (section 10, VI-08) holds the verified table: Codex max, Claude max, Grok xhigh, Cline xhigh, Copilot max.

P10 to P15 (added 2026-10-17, operator answer "1. Yes"): the six findings of the Codex review of pull request 81 (review https://github.com/sharpninja/McpServer/pull/81#pullrequestreview-5554472359 on commit 6dbc384323, posted 2026-10-16T17:48:12 local, after the merge at 17:41:48), each checked against this branch's source on 2026-10-17. Priorities are Codex's (1 and 2); the code came from develop through the branch base.

P10 (unconverted legacy workspace keys; Codex priority 1, discussion_r4300020822): WorkspaceKeyConversion applies CanonicalizeWorkspaceId on write and to query parameters and reads stored values unchanged (src/QBrainAi.Storage/WorkspaceKeyConversion.cs:24-26); no migration since 2026-07-01 on the three providers (the newest on each is 20261005170000_RenameTriageIsMcpServerRelatedColumn) and no other code in src rewrites stored backslash keys (content searches 2026-10-17T08:26:51 and 08:27:10 local). Inference (Codex's, not reproduced): on an upgraded Windows store, rows keyed C:\... stop matching canonical C:/... parameters, so workspace-scoped rows become invisible and bootstrap can create parallel rows. Owner: the federation plan (docs/plans/2026-10-07-federation-fixes.md; PLAN-PATHNORM-001 in this store; IMPL-FEDPATH-001 and FR/TR/TEST-MCP-PATHNORM-001 in the F:\GitHub\McpServer store per docs/handoffs/federation-fixes-handoff-20261016T121400.md:97-98, not in this workspace's store: requirement reads of 2026-10-17T08:30:01 local answered not_found). Its P1.5 (the --workspace-path-rekey command, the startup guard, and the token-store rewrite, by its decisions D5 and D7, plan lines 166-175) is this fix and "has not started" (handoff line 14); the handoff warns not to deploy develop to a server whose database still holds backslash workspace ids (line 16). Codex's suggested provider migration contradicts D5 (no automatic startup migration).

P11 (stop-hook proof unusable; Codex priority 2, discussion_r4300020832): Get-PluginTurnPersistenceProof calls client.SessionLog.GetAsync through Invoke-PluginRepl (plugins/core/lib-ps/plugin-hook.ps1:1041-1065); SessionLogClient.GetAsync returns Task<UnifiedSessionLogDto> (src/QBrainAi.Client/SessionLogClient.cs:95), which is not a case of GenericClientPassthrough.AwaitTaskResultAsync (src/QBrainAi.Repl.Core/GenericClientPassthrough.cs:243-627), so it falls to the throw "Unsupported task result type" (:635-640), and the hook reads no proof and answers Active (plugin-hook.ps1:1063-1087). A supported call would still not carry the fields the hook reads at the top of the result, workspacePath, requestId, outcome, and serverStatus (plugin-hook.ps1:1089-1110): UnifiedSessionLogDto has sourceType, sessionId, status, workspace, and turns, with requestId only inside each turn (src/QBrainAi.Client/Models/SessionLogModels.cs:8-85,108-111). Inference (Codex's, not reproduced): a completed turn behind a stale cache keeps the stop gate blocked. Requirement (corrected 2026-10-17T11:02:08 local from the store read): FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-005 acceptance criterion 2 ("A stale local in_progress turn is reconciled only by authoritative Completed proof for the exact workspace, agent, session, and request"), although the hook cites FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-004 ("exact-turn proof through client.SessionLog.GetAsync", plugin-hook.ps1:1044), a citation the fix corrects; the approved foundation plan PLAN-SESSIONTURNREVIEW-001 rewrites this stop path in its slice A7 (its change to TR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-005: Close-PluginTurnIfNeeded blocks instead of closing, exact-turn proof for every open turn).

P12 (root-relative Windows segment not rooted; Codex priority 2, discussion_r4300020839): WorkspacePathNormalizer.IsWindowsRooted accepts a drive-qualified path and the two UNC spellings only (src/QBrainAi.Client/WorkspacePathNormalizer.cs:161-164), so Combine (:120-144) treats a segment \repo as relative and appends it: root C:/content with segment \repo gives C:/content/repo instead of C:/repo (inferred from the code, not run). Codex: ResolveRepoRootWorkspacePath then resolves a root-relative RepoRoot under the content directory and selects the wrong workspace (not reproduced). Owner: the federation plan, which delivered Combine (P1.3b) and ResolveRepoRootWorkspacePath (P1.4d) (docs/plans/2026-10-07-federation-fixes.md:109,157).

P13 (legacy GitHub token entries unreadable; Codex priority 2, discussion_r4300020846): FileGitHubWorkspaceTokenStore keys entries by the normalized path (src/QBrainAi.Services/Services/FileGitHubWorkspaceTokenStore.cs:317-327; TR-MCP-GH-002 at :14) and compares stored entries with it without normalizing them (:53, :89, :125; the document read at :142 normalizes nothing), so an entry stored as C:\repo no longer matches C:/repo: it cannot be read, an upsert adds a duplicate, and a delete leaves the old secret (Codex; inferred from the code, not run). Owner: the federation plan, whose P1.5 includes this token-store key rewrite (docs/plans/2026-10-07-federation-fixes.md:172).

P14 (descendants survive the root; Codex priority 2, discussion_r4300020851): Stop-ReplChildTree (plugins/core/lib-ps/repl-invoke.ps1:710, called at :771 and :959) calls Kill(true) only when the root process has not exited (:736-738), so a descendant that outlives the root is not killed by it, contrary to FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-004 acceptance criterion 1 ("process-tree cleanup without a stranded child or premature disposal race"). Inference (Codex's): the cleanup loop can only time out, or report success once the pipes close, while the descendant runs on. Every hook call goes through this wrapper (Invoke-PluginRepl runs repl-invoke.ps1, plugin-hook.ps1:230). No open TODO in this workspace names FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-004 (keyword queries 2026-10-17T08:31:31 local); PLAN-SESSIONTURNREVIEW-001 lists FR/TR/TEST-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-004 as related and unchanged.

P15 (stop override returns before the turn is handled; Codex priority 2, discussion_r4300020859): Get-PluginStopEnforcementDecision returns allow after consuming turn-accept-failure.marker for a failed build or turn-accept-incomplete-audit.marker for an incomplete audit (plugins/core/lib-ps/plugin-hook.ps1:991-994,1009-1012); Close-PluginTurnIfNeeded then returns at :1172-1174, before the workflow.sessionlog.completeTurn branch at :1253, so the stop passes while the turn is still in progress in the cache and on the server. Codex suggests continuing through the completion; the approved foundation plan PLAN-SESSIONTURNREVIEW-001 instead makes the stop gate block a delivered request that is still in progress and never call completeTurn or failTurn (its FR-MCP-SESSIONTURN-005 acceptance criteria 1 and 4, which that plan creates and the store does not hold yet, requirement read 2026-10-17T08:36:10 local; its change to TR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-005; slice A7). Requirement today (corrected 2026-10-17T11:02:08 local from the store read): FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-005 ("Stop hook stale pin and session-log uniqueness") acceptance criterion 1 ("Failed-build and incomplete-audit enforcement executes before any stale-pin allow, timestamp refresh, auto-close, or recovery that could bypass those gates"), although the hook cites FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-004 (plugin-hook.ps1:972), a citation the fix corrects.

D-07 settled by the operator on 2026-10-17 (verbatim: "D-07 B: this plan fixes all six (P10 to P15) itself."): the HV plan fixes P10 to P15, each under the owning plan's approved design and through its existing requirement, whose acceptance criteria H0 strengthens with a named test (amendment section 20.4). P10, P12, and P13 in HvStorageSchema before any HV entity is created: P10 and P13 as the federation plan's P1.5 decided them (the rekey maintenance command, its startup guard, and the token-store key rewrite; its D5 and D7; never an automatic startup migration or a dual-key lookup), P12 in the normalizer; H0 first imports FR, TR, and TEST-MCP-PATHNORM-001 into this workspace's store. P11, P14, and P15 in H1, in the PowerShell plugin core synced to every plugin that carries it, before FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC010 is bound to the real hosts; P11 and P15 to the foundation's stop gate (FR-MCP-SESSIONTURN-005: block while a delivered request is in progress, never close a turn). Where an owning plan already delivered the same fix when the phase starts, the phase proves it with the named test and does not change that code again (DRY). D-09, settled by the operator on 2026-10-17 (verbatim: "B"): the existing records these fixes touch (TEST-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-002 and -003, FR-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-004 and -005, TEST-MCP-SESSIONLIFE-002, the PATHNORM-001 import) change in H0 after the plan is approved, not before, because FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003 criterion 4 cites the paused PLAN-SESSIONTRIAGEFIX-001 (amendment commit 6c848a4e).

implementationTasks.task: P1: build the worker FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003 acceptance criterion 4 specifies as its own HostileReviewWorkerHost (amendment section 16.7: attempt storage, renewal, terminal writes with lease release and EndedUtc on every terminal path, completion that returns an accepted result first and carries the execution metadata, the actual model and effort read by the adapters' provenance reader, a sweep through FencedLease Expire that never changes an accepted request, no time limit), sharing only the reviewer adapters and FencedLease (D-02 settled 2026-10-16: the subsystem stays separate), in H3 of PLAN-HVPIPELINE-001, with the named tests of section 16.7 on TEST-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-002 and -003 (recorded in H0 after approval, D-09)
P2: make the accepted terminal result of a hostile review single and fenced (no overwrite on a duplicate completion)

P3: reconcile FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-002 with the todo-only resolver and hash artifact content, not the id; a link refused at its dispatch reauthorization (criteria 1, 2, and 4) launches no process and fails the attempt with its sanitized diagnostic in the request's diagnostic rows, never silently left out of the prompt (amendment section 16.7, named test HostileReviewDispatchRefusedLinkFailsWithDiagnosticNeverOmitted)
